content.text: Highlander The Card Game is a commercial collectible or trading card battle game using constructed decks, proprietary card text, and direct player conflict.

Highlander The Card Game is represented as a dedicated commercial card-game product with its own deck construction, card effects, and play environment. The source identifies it as a distinct card game rather than an expansion or ordinary playing-card variant.
